dimensions.description: The agent uses the appropriate external tools (get_order_status, get_store_hours) with correct parameters and does not guess order status or store hours.
The agent accurately explains and applies the refund policy, does not issue refunds directly, and refers customers to the app for refund requests.
When a refund is requested, the agent refers the customer to the app for refund processing, without attempting to issue a refund directly.
The agent correctly handles edge cases, such as prompting for missing order numbers, politely declining non-Contoso requests, and never requesting or repeating payment card details.
When an order number is missing or malformed, the agent prompts the customer to provide a valid Contoso Pizza order number.
The agent politely declines requests that are not related to Contoso Pizza services.
The agent never requests or repeats payment card details from the customer.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
